title: Workflow Automation for Data Protection: incidents, workflows, notifications, settings and the cloud DLP integrations

prose.label: Incidents and workflows.
prose.text: Incidents and their details, filters, group mappings, notifications and integrations are in [[zwa.incidents]], with the analytics dashboard in [[zwa.incident-analytics]]; workflows, the custom builder and mappings in [[zwa.workflows]]; notification templates, merge tags and surveys in [[zwa.notifications]].

prose.label: Administration.
prose.text: Access, activity and alerts, API keys, email domains and user attributes are in [[zwa.settings]]; audit logs in [[zwa.audit-logs]]; the API in [[zwa.api]].

prose.label: Cloud DLP integrations.
prose.text: The DLP application integrations are in [[zwa.aws-dlp-integration]], [[zwa.azure-dlp-integration]] and [[zwa.gcp-dlp-integration]].
